name: Ψ-2C-T-4
summary: Ψ-2C-T-4, or psi-2C-T-4, also known as 4-isopropylthio-2,6-dimethoxyphenethylamine, is a psychedelic drug of the phenethylamine and Ψ-PEA families. It is a positional isomer of 2C-T-4 (4-isopropylthio-2,5-dimethoxyphenethylamine).

pharmacology.en: Like 2C-T-4, it is thought to act mainly by activating serotonin 5-HT2A receptors.
pharmacology.zh: 一般認為它和 2C-T-4 一樣，主要透過活化血清素 5-HT2A 受體發揮作用。
pharmacology.zhHans: 一般认为它和 2C-T-4 一样，主要通过活化血清素 5-HT2A 受体发挥作用。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Psychedelics of this kind can cause nausea, anxiety, confusion, raised heart rate and blood pressure, and frightening experiences, and can trigger lasting mental health problems in vulnerable people.
sideEffects.zh: 人們對它在人體的作用所知甚少。這類迷幻藥可能引起噁心、焦慮、混亂、心跳和血壓上升以及驚恐的經驗，也可能在較脆弱的人身上誘發持久的精神健康問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 人们对它在人体的作用所知甚少。这类迷幻药可能引起恶心、焦虑、混乱、心跳和血压上升以及惊恐的经验，也可能在较脆弱的人身上诱发持久的精神健康问题。

fact.en: It has the same atoms as 2C-T-4, but its groups sit in a 2,4,6 pattern on the benzene ring instead of the 2,4,5 pattern of 2C-T-4, an arrangement Alexander Shulgin marked with the Greek letter psi.
fact.zh: 它和 2C-T-4 的原子組成相同，但苯環上的基團呈 2,4,6 排列，而不是 2,4,5 排列，Alexander Shulgin 以希臘字母 psi（Ψ）來標示這種排列。
fact.zhHans: 它和 2C-T-4 的原子组成相同，但苯环上的基团呈 2,4,6 排列，而不是 2,4,5 排列，Alexander Shulgin 以希腊字母 psi（Ψ）来标示这种排列。
